validationPlan.runs: every member and every native transfer vector: one continuous FULL run 2016-01-04 → 2026-10-30 per ETF (forward split adjustment), boundary 2024-12-31
reportOnly: 10 and 20 bps per side and 14% interest on FULL

validation-window neighbourhood: the C24 confirmation rep-1 draws (128) of every shortlisted ETF’s actual-profit holder and the universe primary — share positive, median and p10 validation P&L, p90 reset and whole-run DD, breaches
native full-history targets of the transfer vectors on VGT and GDX
a 2025–2026 data-integrity scan of the validated ETFs (split-sized moves after adjustment; moves ≥ 15%)
validationPlan.failureMeaning: a failed validation is a result: no new winner, no swap, no rescue search, no retuning; the shortlist and the 7B export are not changed by validation
